mentions.name: dotIPA
mentions.description: dotIPA is a paid iOS app build size inspector that runs locally on macOS. It tracks app size growth over time, lets users inspect build contents, and helps spot duplication and size bloat.
mentions.problem: iOS app builds can grow in size over time, with duplication and bloat that is hard to spot.
mentions.source_excerpt:
dotIPA, an iOS app build size inspector that runs locally on your macOS [$4.99]
Track app size growth over time, inspect contents, spot duplication and size bloat and more.
